title: Project list that shows the server's error
describe: a project list loaded from an API that shows the server's error message
prompt:
Build a projects page at /projects that loads GET /api/projects (the server is not built; it is added later).

The API answers with a JSON list of {"id", "name"} when it works. When it fails it answers with a non-2xx status and, usually, a JSON body {"error": "<message>", "code": "<code>"}.

Requirements:
- A heading "Projects".
- Each project's name in a list.
- A button "Retry" that is always visible and loads the list again.
- On a failure with a JSON body, show the body's "error" text in an alert.
- On a failure whose body is not JSON (a proxy's HTML page, say), show "Could not load projects" and never show the body itself.
